posts.text: Pharmacy First can help with acute sore throat (including suspected streptococcal infection) when NHS pathway criteria are met.
Pharmacy First can help with acute otitis media (earache) when NHS pathway criteria are met.

Pharmacy First can help with impetigo when NHS pathway criteria are met. Banner Cross Pharmacy + Travel Vaccinations & Weight Loss Clinic in Sheffield can assess symptoms and explain next steps. Call 0114 266 2208 (Sheffield).
Pharmacy First can help with infected insect bites and stings when NHS pathway criteria are met.
Pharmacy First can help with shingles (herpes zoster) when NHS pathway criteria are met.

Pharmacy First can help with acute sinusitis when NHS pathway criteria are met. Banner Cross Pharmacy + Travel Vaccinations & Weight Loss Clinic in Sheffield can assess symptoms and explain next steps. Call 0114 266 2208 (Sheffield).
Pharmacy First can help with uncomplicated urinary tract infection (women 16–64) when NHS pathway criteria are met.
